tier: prepaid traffic, billed per downloaded GB

free_tier.stated: 'Мы дарим 150 мб тестового трафика на все файлообменники' on the home page; a second block on the same page says 'Зарегистрируйтесь и получите 100 MB тестового трафика'. No recurring free allowance.
free_tier.notes: The two trial figures are both on the home page (150 MB in one block, 100 MB in another).

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: it forwards a link to the source host; no maximum file size published on the pages that would render

retention.stated: not applicable: no storage is sold, only the download of a link that already exists at the source host

egress.terms: Speed is stated as 'свыше 1 МБ/сек' on the home page and 'up to 5 Mbit/sec' on each per-host page. Traffic is prepaid and billed per downloaded GB ('Payment is made for each downloaded 1 GB of traffic'); the balance has no validity limit.
egress.price_per_tb: USD 300 per TB (USD 0.30 per GB on the turbobit.net page)

interface_detail: Web form: paste a link, the service fetches it ('Загрузка в один клик'). The account terms state a full API for each account ('каждому аккаунту предоставляется полноценное API'); its protocol and documentation were not found.
tooling: Browser form, plus an account API stated in the terms. Generated links are valid for up to 24 hours ('Созданные ссылки имеют срок действия до 24 часов со времени генерации'), and the output is a download served by transload.me, so a download manager can take it.
chaining: A cheap per-GB top-up for the handful of hosts a seedbox cannot reach; not a substitute for a full debrid because the host list is 28 names and the speed floor is 1 MB/s.

limits.value: home page: 'свыше 1 МБ/сек' (above 1 MB/s); each per-host page: 'Download speed up to 5 Mbit/sec'
prepaid balance billed per downloaded GB (USD 0.30 per GB on the turbobit.net page); the balance has no validity limit; bonus discounts of up to 50% on large deposits

limits_note: 28 hosts are named in the service picker (1fichier, ddownload, elfile, elitefile, emload, file.al, fileaxa, fileboom, filedot, filextras, gigapeta, hitfile, isra.cloud, jumploads, katfile, keep2share, kshared, mega.nz, nitroflare, prefiles, rapidgator, rg.to, terabytez, tezfiles, turbobit, upstore, wdupload, world-files). The marketing block still lists 18-20 legacy hosts including Uploaded and Letitbit.
binding_note: The home page promises 'свыше 1 МБ/сек' while each per-host page states 'Download speed up to 5 Mbit/sec' (0.625 MB/s); the two figures disagree, so the sustained speed that decides a month of transfer is unverified. The prepaid GB balance at USD 0.30 per GB is the second constraint.

identity_cost.detail: The register form takes an e-mail address and a password behind a reCAPTCHA; the terms state 'Для работы с сервисом от пользователя требуется только электронная почта'.

reliability_note: The /ru/?p=price tariff page returns an empty body to the readers tried; the per-host pages under /en/premium/ carry the per-GB price. The third-party group-buy thread that carried an earlier RUB price answers 'Запитана тема не знайдена' (topic not found) on 2026-11-03.
confidence_note: The host list, the per-GB price, the speed statements and the account terms are vendor-stated pages read on 2026-11-03. The registration trial credit is unverified: its text was not on the home page as served that day, and the vendor tariff page at /ru/?p=price returns an empty body.
